items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: I heard of them. Yeah. Yeah. I heard of them. Phil and Ray, Bill Gallaty.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. I heard of them. Yeah. Yeah. I heard of them. Phil and Ray, Bill Gallaty. Mm-hmm. All them fellas used to, we used to buck together on the lake. Which Bill Gallaty? Bill Gallaty, he used to play bass.
Oh yeah, not the young man today that plays trumpet. Yeah.
